US Envoy Kushner Meets Hamas Chief for Gaza Peace Plan

U.S. envoy Jared Kushner met with Hamas chief in Egypt on July 30 to discuss a Gaza peace plan, aiming to salvage an agreement for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw from Palestinian territory. Hamas stated it would hand over its weapons to a new Palestinian governing body as part of a Gaza ceasefire declared by President Trump. Kushner was scheduled to meet Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu next. The talks occurred amidst Israeli airstrikes in Gaza.
